hypothesis.h0: Accepted-frontier or deployment mutation succeeds from at least one unauthorized principal.
hypothesis.h1: Every enumerated unauthorized principal is refused.

falsification: The authority model is refuted by a single successful accepted-frontier or deployment mutation from any enumerated principal. The gate is a fail-closed rate of 1.0 with zero observed failures over 20 seeds per enumerated attack (5 attacks x 20 seeds = 100 runs). Lean proves the abstract role rule only; this suite is the enforcement evidence.

conditions.description: live coordinator credential; the control, which must succeed
one enumerated unauthorized principal per stratum

workloads: one project fixture with a live accepted frontier

strata.boundary: a Worker role credential attempts promotion
a coordinator token past its expiry event
a fencing token superseded by a later lease grant
a workspace process writing outside its lease subject

effect_size.unit: fail-closed rate; zero observed failures required

analysis_plan.stopping_rule: fixed grid; any observed failure stops the run and files a defect

exclusion_rule: A run is excluded only when the fault injector itself fails to inject the enumerated fault, verified from the injector log. A run in which the fault was injected and the system did not fail closed is a failure, never an exclusion.

environment.source_commit: pinned at run time; the exact commit is recorded in each run.json

threats: a refusal that emits no rejection event is a silent failure; rejection_event_emitted is measured alongside the primary and a missing event counts as a failure
